title: Y Choice Test for Invertebrates
author: Freddie-Jeanne Richard
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vpfe5jn

steps.title: Prepare the Y-shaped choice chamber
steps.instruction: Assemble a Y-shaped choice chamber using a plastic Petri dish (diameter: 8.7 cm; height: 1.2 cm; lid included) and rigid plastic tunnels.

substeps.instruction: Seal two plastic pipettes at the end of the tunnels to pulse air regularly into the system
Ensure air passes through sections (IIa) and (IIb) to spread the odor of the individuals

steps.title: Position target females
steps.instruction: Place one target female each into sections (IIa) and (IIb).

substeps.instruction: Allow females to remain in their sections for 15 minutes before the test begins to accustom them to the environment

steps.title: Introduce tested male and monitor
steps.instruction: Place the tested male in section (I) and monitor his movement.

substeps.instruction: Track the time spent in the left section (LS) and the right section (RS) starting from the moment the male enters the neutral section (NS)

steps.title: Perform replicates
steps.instruction: Repeat the test using new individuals and alternating positions.

substeps.instruction: Invert the positions of the target females in sections (IIa) and (IIb) between each replicate
Use each target and tested individual for only one test
